text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the arrival of summer, Aston Machan 
fully regained her energy. Let's train 
thoroughly and prepare for the Sprinters 
Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, rumors quickly spread that she 
had made a sudden route change without 
consulting anyone—and those rumors soon 
reached the ears of Hishi Amazon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Reporting something important to Trainer 
after the fact... Worried, she decided to 
check Aston Machan's livestream.
